findings.message: a chart whose job is to answer a question states its insight; this title only names the data
findings.supply: an insight title (title.kind insight, the descriptive line under it); a callout (comments[], answers: [important]); or job.kind lookup if the chart is for looking values up
findings.title: the key insight stated in the title or a callout, when the job is to answer, persuade or make aware (G8.2, owner 30 Sep 2026)

source.shows: the same chart with a job that answers a question: its descriptive title does not state the insight, so it is refused (G8.2, locked for answer, persuade and make-aware jobs); as a look-up chart (above) it passes

path.name: brief
path.text: job answer: insight “East has the most employees and North the fewest”

path.name: table or graph
path.text: a graph, the values to be compared or a pattern seen (G1.11)

path.name: variables
path.text: one plot: categories along x and 1 series; a further variable would go to small multiples (data.dims, G1.18)

path.name: location
path.text: not a map: where the values are is not the message (facts.location_matters; G1.24, G1.25)

path.name: parts of a total
path.text: not parts of a total (no data.parts, no breakdown message; G1.1)

path.name: values across categories
path.text: group: bar charts. Values compared across categories (G1.9)

path.name: values across categories
path.text: one scale from zero: bars, sorted by value when the categories are nominal (02 D1)

path.name: avoid-list
path.text: bar charts are not on the avoid-list (G1.61)
